channel.title: Wrenfield Township: Public Notices
channel.description: Legal and public notices from Wrenfield Township, Tarrow County, Ohio. Fictional sample feed for the weekly-digest kit.

item.title: Road closure: Kessler Road culvert replacement, October 12 to 16
item.description: Kessler Road will be closed between Gable Road and Township Line Road from October 12 to October 16, 2026 for culvert replacement. Detour signs will be posted.

item.title: Notice of public hearing: Zoning Text Amendment ZTA-2026-03 (battery energy storage systems)
item.description: The Wrenfield Township Zoning Commission will hold a public hearing on Wednesday, October 21, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. at the Township Hall on proposed zoning amendments for battery energy storage systems. Written comments are accepted until 4:00 p.m. on Friday, October 16, 2026.

item.title: Trustees regular meeting, October 1, 2026
item.description: The Board of Trustees will hold its regular meeting on Thursday, October 1, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. at the Township Hall.

item.title: Fall leaf collection schedule
item.description: Curbside leaf collection runs from October 19 to November 20, 2026.

item.title: Board of Zoning Appeals: October meeting cancelled
item.description: There are no cases for the October meeting of the Board of Zoning Appeals, so the meeting is cancelled.
